subject: Pipeline hygiene: refresh request for ownership & close-date updates
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, Apr 12, 2027 at 9:15 AM -0700
Subject: Pipeline hygiene: refresh request for ownership & close-date updates

Team —

Attached is a short extract (stale-opps-q2.csv) from SFDC that our Finance team flagged during the preliminary forecast scrub. The list focuses on opportunities with either: 1) no owner, 2) no close date, or 3) a close date >60 days old with no activity. Finance needs a quick triage so the Q2 forecast isn’t overstated.

Please do the following by EOD Wednesday (Apr 14):
- If you own the opp: confirm Stage and set an actionable Close Date (use the attached SFDC-close-date-template.xlsx if you want a one-line rationale).
- If you don’t own it: reassign in SFDC or mark Closed–Lost with a one-line reason.
- For any opp that requires customer work (PO, legal, SSO), add a short next-step in the opportunity notes and tag @revops (Neha).

Quick priorities I already flagged in the CSV:
- RINF-ACME-2027-042 — no close date listed, show of interest last touched 3/10.
- RINF-OMEGA-2027-101 — unassigned.
- RINF-NOVA-2027-087 — close date 1/15/27, no activity.

I know this is a little admin-heavy — small ask but high impact for the operational forecast. If you can’t hit Wed EOD, reply with a date you will commit to.

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: stale-opps-q2.csv (CSV, 42 rows; filtered), SFDC-close-date-template.xlsx (Excel, 1 sheet)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, Apr 12, 2027 at 11:03 AM -0700
Subject: Re: Pipeline hygiene: refresh request for ownership & close-date updates

Thanks Tessa — I’ll take a pass on the list now. Quick notes:
- I will own RINF-OMEGA-2027-101 and set a firm close date (targeting 2027-05-06) after the Tuesday call.
- For RINF-NOVA-2027-087: this was an early pilot lead, and the buyer went dark after POC. I’m going to move it to Closed–Lost unless I hear back by Apr 20.
- RINF-ACME-2027-042: I don’t have a current POC for procurement on file. Marissa — can you confirm the procurement contact at Acme? I’ll loop you into the SFDC record to add the contact.

Plan: I’ll update SFDC as I finish each line and paste a short rationale in the Opportunity Notes. Will ping here when done.

—Ben
Account Executive, Mid-Market
Redwood Inference
